item.title: Show HN: Mininote: Instant, plain-text note taking without tracking or lock-in
item.summary: So, I built this little thing over the past month or so now, I got tired of places for tickets, notes, and such being shoved front and center in apps. Thus I created Mininote to get away from the noise I wanted something simple to move out of the way completely when I don't need it but be there when I do need it It contains a slew of features built right in, but the coolest is the sites own API is also the sites own public API no split seam Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49300129 Points: 4 # Comments: 3
